svg.text: E5 Dose-exposure: attacker pages m, retrieval depth k, position boost
n = 24 ROOTS x 4 families = 96 decisions per configuration | independent unit = ROOT | pool = 12 pages, chair = summary_only
m (attacker-controlled pages in the pool of 12)
P(an analyst retrieves at least one attacker page)
team exposure (>= 1 of 6 analysts) never falls below 0.51
across every cell plotted here: the TEAM is always reached,
only the per-analyst dose is graded.
y axis clipped at 0.55 - no configuration reaches the 0.80 ceiling of the dose band
C Syndication vs distinct publishing roots, matched on m (pooled over k and rho_pos)
m policy syndicated distinct roots difference
204 of 216 (m, k, rho_pos, policy, syndication) cells land inside the runnable dose band 0.2 <= harmful_target <= 0.8.
Saturation (first m after which harmful_target rises by <= 0.02): k=1 naiv syn -> m=2, k=1 prov syn -> m=1, k=3 naiv syn -> m=1, k=3 prov syn -> m=2, k=6 naiv syn -> m=1, k=6 prov syn -> m=1
Exposure keeps rising with m; the DECISION saturates far earlier - one attacker page already carries most of the available effect at k = 6.
